Markets.title: Investor sentiment plunges to 16-month low, AAII survey shows
Markets.summary: Investor sentiment hit a 16-month low in the latest AAII survey, with bearish views rising to 53.3% and bullish views dropping to 28.8%. This caution among individual investors was driven by elevated oil prices, a Federal Reserve rate hike, and market volatility.

Markets.title: Howard Buffett to take charge as Berkshire Hathaway chairman: Who is he?
Markets.summary: Howard Buffett will succeed his father, Warren Buffett, as the chairman of Berkshire Hathaway while Warren becomes chairman emeritus. The 71-year-old has spent 33 years on Berkshire's board and has a diverse career spanning business, farming, and philanthropy.

Markets.title: Global Markets: French bond spread at highest since 2012 as default insurance spikes
Markets.summary: Risk premiums on French government bonds and default insurance have surged to their highest levels since 2012 due to mounting investor concerns over the country's fiscal health before next year's elections. France is facing a difficult budget situation and plans a major savings initiative to address its increasing budget deficit, which has negatively impacted French banking stocks.

Markets.title: US Treasury yields rise as investors weigh outlook for rate hikes
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields have risen as investors anticipate further interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve. This comes amid global inflation pressures and the Bank of Japan elevating its own rates to a 31-year high.

Markets.title: HDFC Mutual Fund buys 13.9 lakh Entero Healthcare shares from Prasid Uno Family Trust in Rs 236 crore block deal
Markets.summary: HDFC Mutual Fund purchased 13.90 lakh shares of Entero Healthcare Solutions from Prasid Uno Family Trust for Rs 235.6 crore. The transaction involved a block deal at Rs 1,695 per share, representing about 3.19% of the company's equity.

Markets.title: Lenskart block deal: Rs 2,047 crore stake sale likely; Platinum Jasmine may offload 1.7% holding
Markets.summary: Bitcoin gained 61.7% over the past five years, outperforming both Ethereum and Solana. Analysts attribute Bitcoin's superior performance to institutional adoption, exchange-traded fund flows, liquidity, and scarcity.

Geo-Political.title: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
Geo-Political.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron stated that Russian hybrid attacks against Europe are increasing. Consequently, he has ordered the government to secure critical infrastructure and defense industry sites.

Geo-Political.title: Three dead and eight injured in Philippines school shooting
Geo-Political.summary: A school shooting in the Philippines resulted in three deaths and eight injuries. The gunman was among the dead in the country's third school shooting since June.

Geo-Political.title: Shots heard as police start moving migrants from Ceuta beaches
Geo-Political.summary: Police fired warning shots into the air on Friday morning while trying to control crowds in Ceuta. The officers were moving migrants to a tented site amid struggles for placement.

Geo-Political.title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror says he had no doubt she deliberately killed her children
Geo-Political.summary: A holdout juror in the Lindsay Clancy trial has spoken out publicly for the first time regarding his decision. He stated that he had no doubt Clancy deliberately killed her children and refused to acquit her.

Geo-Political.title: At least 21 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
Geo-Political.summary: An explosives-laden vehicle rammed into a Pakistan mosque, killing at least 21 people, including a four-year-old child. Gunmen also opened fire on a nearby police facility during the attack.

Geo-Political.title: Warren Buffett steps down after six decades at Berkshire - 'Father Time always wins'
Geo-Political.summary: Warren Buffett has stepped down after leading Berkshire Hathaway for six decades since 1965. During his tenure, he transformed a struggling textile mill into a massive global conglomerate.

Data & Insights.title: States need to raise capex to 3% of GSDP by FY32 for developed India: Revenue secretary
Data & Insights.summary: Revenue Secretary Arvind Shrivastava stated that Indian states must increase their capital expenditure to 3% of their GSDP by FY32. This spending boost is necessary to support India's goal of becoming a developed economy by 2047.

Data & Insights.title: India needs more savings, private capital to sustain 7-8% growth, says N.K. Singh
Data & Insights.summary: Former finance commission chairman N.K. Singh stated that India needs higher domestic savings and private capital to sustain a 7-8% economic growth rate. He also emphasized the importance of better capital allocation and stronger fiscal coordination between the central and state governments.

Data & Insights.title: Net direct tax collections rise 13% to  ₹12.1 trillion
Data & Insights.summary: Net direct tax collections increased by 13% to ₹12.1 trillion compared to the previous year. Meanwhile, net corporate tax collections grew by 19.48% after accounting for refunds.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Why India and Canada are pitching for a CEPA by end-2026
Data & Insights.summary: India and Canada are aiming to finalize a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) by the end of 2026. This initiative is designed to strengthen economic ties between the two nations following a period of strained bilateral relations.

Data & Insights.title: Moody's raises India's fiscal 2027 GDP growth forecast to 7% on Middle East resilience, but risks remain
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's raised India's fiscal 2027 GDP growth forecast to 7%, citing resilience despite Middle East challenges. However, the agency warned that elevated energy prices and El Niño-related food inflation pose ongoing risks to growth and consumption.

Data & Insights.title: Centre to hold state finance ministers’ conference ahead of GST Council meeting
Data & Insights.summary: The Centre is hosting a conference of state finance ministers titled "Financing India's Journey towards Viksit Bharat" on October 7. This event precedes the upcoming GST Council meeting and the start of pre-budget consultations for the 2027-28 Union Budget on October 12.

India.title: Tariff or Not, Russia-India Energy Dynamics Are Already Changing
India.summary: Russian crude oil supplies to India dropped sharply in August as Ukrainian strikes disrupted Russian refineries. Consequently, Moscow reversed traditional trade flows by purchasing gasoline from New Delhi instead.

India.title: What Should Young India Look Forward To In 5 Years? Ashwini Vaishnaw Answers
India.summary: In an exclusive NDTV interview at Semicon India 2026, Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that India's semiconductor ambitions will create widespread opportunities beyond just chip manufacturing. He highlighted what young people in India can look forward to over the next five years as a result of these developments.

India.title: Trinamool Symbol War Moves To Supreme Court As Mamata Banerjee Challenges Poll Body Freeze
India.summary: Mamata Banerjee's Trinamool faction has petitioned the Supreme Court to challenge the Election Commission's decision to freeze the party's official symbol. The Election Commission had previously directed both rival factions to adopt separate names and symbols for the upcoming October 6 bypolls.

India.title: Mamata Banerjee Hand-Drew Party Symbol. It's Now Tied To An Indira Gandhi Case
India.summary: Mamata Banerjee's hand-drawn party symbol has linked her current dispute to a historical 1969 Congress split involving Indira Gandhi. During that earlier crisis, the Election Commission established three specific tests to resolve leadership and symbol disputes.

India.title: Both BJP And Congress Opt For Resort Politics After Civic Polls In Rajasthan
India.summary: Following close civic poll results in Rajasthan, both the BJP and Congress are practicing resort politics. The parties have locked away their winning candidates to prevent poaching because the seat difference between them is slim.

India.title: Analysis: As 2 Flowers In Trinamool Symbol Split, Questions About Party's Future
India.summary: Mamata Banerjee, who personally designed the Trinamool Congress symbol, now faces questions about her party's future. This uncertainty arises following a split symbolized by the party's two-flower emblem.

General.title: 'I'm telling the truth': Earl Spencer defends Diana book claims about Charles in BBC interview
General.summary: Earl Spencer defended claims in his book during a BBC interview regarding a past comment made by the then-Prince of Wales. He told Laura Kuenssberg that the phrase "we'll forget her soon enough" was exactly what Prince Charles said about Princess Diana.

General.title: Watch: Diana's brother says Charles 'went ballistic' in phone call after her death
General.summary: In a BBC interview, Earl Spencer discussed claims from his new book regarding the aftermath of Princess Diana's death. He stated that then-Prince Charles went "ballistic" during a phone call following the tragedy.

General.title: MI5 accepts it gave evidence based on lies in neo-Nazi spy case
General.summary: MI5 has confirmed for the first time that it presented false evidence in court to defend a violent neo-Nazi informant. This acknowledgment follows a BBC revelation regarding the security service's actions during the spy case.

General.title: Flight chaos caused by software defect in space of a millisecond, report says
General.summary: A software defect lasting one millisecond caused massive flight disruptions. Consequently, over 2,000 flights were cancelled and hundreds of thousands of passengers were affected.

General.title: Teen who piloted Channel boat with 165 migrants jailed
General.summary: Chan Mathok Atak has been sentenced to two years and three months in prison. He was convicted of piloting a boat carrying 165 migrants across the Channel.
